title: SHABBIR BAHARHAAL TERA NAAM RAHEGA
body:
Har aalame nao me Karame aam rahega
Har dukh me dawaa-e dile na kaam rahega
Duniyaa-e digar ke liye paighaam rahega
<<MINI>>
Duniya ye na hogi magar Islam Rahega
Shabbir Baharhaal Tera Naam Rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
Maana ke zamaane ka rahega na ye aalam
Tarteeb tamaddum ki ye ho jaaygi barHam
Phir aur Kisi rang me hoga Tera Maatam
<<MINI>>
Duniya ye na hogi magar Islam Rahega
Shabbir Baharhaal Tera Naam Rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
Zarro'n ki zaba'n par hai Teri Tashna dahani
Taaro'n ki hai dekhi huwi Akbar ki Jawani
Bhoolegi na fitrat Ali Asghar ki Kahani
<<MINI>>
Duniya ye na hogi magar Islam Rahega
Shabbir Baharhaal Tera Naam Rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
Mooh Gham se nikal aayega dariya ka zara sa
Paani ye kahega koi maara gaya pyaasa
Saahil ye pukarega MuHammad ka Nawasa
<<MINI>>
Duniya ye na hogi magar Islam Rahega
Shabbir Baharhaal Tera Naam Rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
Aghlab hai ke Turbat me Tadap jaaygi Maadar
Karrar ke Madfan me badal jaaynge tewar
Phir Qabr e shaayad nikal Aayenge Payambar
<<MINI>>
Duniya ye na hogi magar Islam Rahega
Shabbir Baharhaal Tera Naam Rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Najm ulat jaayga ye Pardaye Ghaybat
Niklega udhar tegh bakaf Markaze Hujjat
Karti huwi Maatam idhar aayegi Qayamt
<<MINI>>
Duniya ye na hogi magar Islam Rahega
Shabbir Baharhaal Tera Naam Rahega
author: Najm Aafandi
